headline: Nevish Line Erupts; Linn Mercy Shifts to Colonials
war_summary:
The lines have moved again since the last edition. Linn Mercy, which stood eight Colonial works against two Warden at the earlier filing, now reads nine Colonial to a single Warden hold with one work unclaimed, and its guns have been busy within the last two hours. Weathered Expanse has narrowed its unclaimed ground from three works to two, the Wardens now standing at seven, while Palantine Berm holds unchanged at four Warden and three Colonial and has fallen quiet. Godcrofts keeps all nine works in Colonial hands, its heaviest churn now eased. Marban Hollow holds at four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed.

The sharpest new fighting is on the Nevish Line, where six actions in two hours came with roughly 885 Colonial and 818 Warden casualties, a sudden surge after a near-silent prior window. Fisherman's Row saw fresh actions about Oceanwatch. Callahan's Passage again reports the heaviest killing of the day, near 2,700 Colonial and 1,800 Warden fallen in two hours, while the Dead Lands exacted the stiffer Warden toll. The victory mark remains thirty-four towns.
